facts.value: If gm_8016B0B4() is true and x221F_b4 is clear, reads signed integer coins C, computes L=C/2, writes Player_SetCoins(player_id,C-L), and adds the uncapped L to Player_GetUnk9C through Player_SetUnk9C. facts.value: The guard encloses all local accounting and generator calls. On its accepted branch accounting precedes exactly one it_802E5F8C request, including when the amount is zero; no result is checked and no rollback or synchronization is implemented. This is sequential guarded processing, not a proved atomic transaction.

facts.value: Supplies the countdown-driven handoff from the active Rebirth callback suite into RebirthWait: after calling ftCo_8008A7A8, it decrements common.x0 and invokes ftCo_800D5600 only when the new value equals zero. RebirthWait is a separate waiting phase, not necessarily stationary; its physics continues destination-based or paired-entity X/Y velocity updates.
facts.rationale: Replaces the incorrect stationary-wait characterization with active-table and callback evidence.

facts.value: Rebirth and RebirthWait animation callbacks decrement common.x0 and test equality with zero, not <=0. Initial 1 triggers the handoff on that invocation; initial 0 becomes -1 and does not. Their physics callbacks perform unguarded reciprocal-countdown multiplication on the clear-x221F_b4 branch and copy logical entity 0's X/Y velocity on the set branch without a null check. Wait timeout applies ftColl_8007B7A4 before Fall; accepted IASA paths apply it after the action/Fall path and additionally call pl_80040374. Collision passes fn_800D5A30 to a synchronous conditional helper; that callback calls ftColl_8007B7A4 then ft_8008A2BC. Positive timer configuration, finite inputs, compiled initialization overlap and scheduling across transitions remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Records verified boundary/order behavior while preserving unresolved invariants rather than assuming safe countdowns or complete downstream semantics.
